subject: Re: Onboarding path — PO-required vs invoice-only for pilot (Zendo Analytics)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Thomas Miller <thomas.miller@zendo-analytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding path — PO-required vs invoice-only for pilot

Hi Thomas —

Great to speak earlier. Quick follow-up on the onboarding route for the 6-week pilot you mentioned. Two inputs from our side determine the path: PO capability on your side (can you issue POs for pilots) and evidence we need for invoice-only exceptions.

Options:
- Standard: PO issued by Zendo, vendor created in our system, normal 30-day terms.
- Invoice-only (conditional): limited to single invoices under $7,500 for pilots, requires W9 + vendor onboarding form + two finance references; pre-approved by Procurement and Finance for the pilot only.

Can you confirm whether Zendo can generate a PO for this engagement? If not, please send the completed vendor onboarding form and W9 (I’ve attached the onboarding form template).

Next steps: if no PO, we’ll route a conditional exception to Finance; that typically takes 48–72 hours. If yes, we’ll start vendor setup and hand off to Billing.

Thanks —
Jordan
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: zendo_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 180KB)
From: Thomas Miller <thomas.miller@zendo-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@zendo-analytics.com
Date: 2026-02-18T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding path — PO-required vs invoice-only for pilot

Hi Jordan —

Thanks — unfortunately Zendo’s current procurement process won’t issue a PO for a short pilot. Our AP team only issues POs for contractual engagements > $25k. We can do invoice-only. I’ve attached our W9 and a signed vendor intake PDF.

Files attached:
- zendo_w9.pdf
- zendo_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (completed)

We’re happy to provide two finance references (clients that pay net-30) and do a short SOW for the pilot. Let me know what evidence is needed to get the exception approved.

Best,
Thomas Miller
Head of Finance Ops
Zendo Analytics
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Thomas Miller <thomas.miller@zendo-analytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-18T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding path — PO-required vs invoice-only for pilot

Thomas / Jordan —

Thanks for the quick response and the attachments. With the W9 and completed onboarding form we can start a conditional exception assessment. For our Approval Matrix (short form):

Required for invoice-only pilot exception (pilot <= $7.5k):
- Completed vendor onboarding form (received)
- W9 (received)
- Two customer references or evidence of timely payments (name + contact)
- Signed SOW or statement of work for pilot (scope + budget capped at $7.5k)
- AP contact for remittance (procure@zendo-analytics.com is fine)

If all items are present, Procurement will submit for Finance provisional approval. The provisional approval includes: one-time invoice-only authorization for pilot, invoice routing to Accounts Payable, and a requirement that the vendor be converted to PO-enabled on any follow-on engagements > $7.5k.

I’ve attached our internal checklist and a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we generally use. Please provide references and a draft SOW and I’ll expedite.

Attachments: no_po_evidence_checklist.pdf, draft-MAP.docx

-Karthik
Head of Procurement (on behalf of Finance)
From: Thomas Miller <thomas.miller@zendo-analytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-02-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding path — PO-required vs invoice-only for pilot

Karthik —

Thanks, we can do the SOW. I’m looping in AP to confirm remittance details (procure@zendo-analytics.com). Two references below (finance contacts at current customers):

- Mira Santos, Controller, HarborLabs — mira.santos@harborlabs.io
- Omar Ruiz, Head of FP&A, LumenPath — omar.ruiz@lumenpath.ai

Draft SOW: short pilot, 4 weeks, up to $6,800 total. I’ll attach a signed copy by EOD.

Thomas

Approved: Finance is comfortable with a one-time invoice-only exception for this pilot under the conditions Karthik listed. Caveats: the pilot must be capped at $7,500; we need the SOW signed before the first invoice; and Zendo must commit to being PO-capable for any follow-on purchase > $7,500.

Jordan — please confirm you have the signed SOW and the two references in the HubSpot deal record; once confirmed I’ll route the exception memo to Accounting and copy in Finance for final sign-off.
